## Story
As a <who>, I want <what>, so that <why>.
(For a task without a user, one sentence saying what and why.)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Verifiable, with a number when there is one (Hz, ms, mm, %).

## Safety
Does this touch motion, e-stop, limits or the hardware? yes / no.
If yes, what is the safe state while it is being tested?

## Test checklist
- [ ] Unit test
- [ ] Run in simulation
- [ ] Run on the real arm (if applicable)
